package cache

import "time"

var now = time.Now

type entry struct {
	value int
	setAt time.Time
	used  uint64
}

// tick orders entries by when they were last used. A clock would do it
// too until two uses land in the same instant, and then which entry is
// evicted depends on map order.
var tick uint64

func use() uint64 {
	tick++
	return tick
}

type Cache struct {
	capacity int
	ttl      time.Duration
	items    map[string]*entry
}

func New(capacity int, ttl time.Duration) *Cache {
	return &Cache{capacity: capacity, ttl: ttl, items: map[string]*entry{}}
}

func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value int) {
	if len(c.items) >= c.capacity {
		c.evict()
	}
	c.items[key] = &entry{value: value, setAt: now(), used: use()}
}

func (c *Cache) evict() {
	var oldest string
	var at uint64
	for k, e := range c.items {
		if oldest == "" || e.used < at {
			oldest, at = k, e.used
		}
	}
	delete(c.items, oldest)
}

func (c *Cache) Get(key string) (int, bool) {
	e, ok := c.items[key]
	if !ok {
		return 0, false
	}
	e.used = use()
	if now().Sub(e.setAt) > c.ttl {
		return 0, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *Cache) Len() int {
	return len(c.items)
}
